# Yaser Bakhtiar | یاسر بختیار | ياسر بختيار

> Official personal website of Yaser Bakhtiar. He is an Afghan Quran Hafiz from Herat, a law student at Lusail University in Qatar and a volunteer Arabic teacher.

## Names and identity

- Legal and public name: یاسر بختیار (Persian), ياسر بختيار (Arabic), Yaser Bakhtiar (English).
- Search aliases for this same person: یاسر بختیار هروی, ياسر بختيار الهروي, Yaser Bakhtiar Herawi, Yaser Bakhtiar Heravi.
- His family name is Bakhtiar (بختیار). Yaser Bakhtiari (یاسر بختیاری), the Iranian musician known as Yas (یاس), is a different person.
- The canonical identity for this profile is https://yaserbakhtiar.tr/#person.

## Education and work

- From Herat, Afghanistan, and based in Doha, Qatar. He memorized the complete Quran and studies law at Lusail University.
- He teaches Arabic online as a volunteer at Al Hijaz Institute in Kabul, where he previously studied Arabic. His teaching role began on 4 November 2026.
- His experience includes teaching Quran memorization and the Prophet’s biography, presenting Quran radio programmes, hosting events and translating between Persian and Arabic.
- He speaks Persian (native), Arabic (advanced) and English (basic).

## Projects he founded

- [Falah Group | مجموعه فلاح | مجموعة فلاح](https://yaserbakhtiar.tr/#falah) publishes Islamic educational content for Persian speakers.
- [ScholarVid | اسکالر وید](https://scholarvid.tr) helps Afghan students find scholarships and apply to international universities.
- [Diwan Al Minah | ديوان المنح](https://diwanalminah.com) offers scholarship and admissions guidance to international applicants.
